package merge_test

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/consensys/gnark-crypto/ecc"
	"github.com/consensys/gnark/backend/groth16"
	bn254 "github.com/consensys/gnark/backend/groth16/bn254"
	"github.com/consensys/gnark/frontend"
	"github.com/consensys/gnark/frontend/cs/r1cs"
	merge "zolana/prover/circuits/spp_merge"
	transaction "zolana/prover/circuits/spp_transaction/shared"
	"zolana/prover/prover-test/spp/protocol"
	"zolana/prover/prover-test/spp/spptest"
	"zolana/prover/prover/common"
)

func TestGenerateProgramMergeCacheFixture(t *testing.T) {
	for _, ring := range []bool{false, true} {
		options := mergeFixtureOptions{eddsa: true}
		name, key, tag := "merge", "merge_8_1", byte(17)
		if ring {
			options.rail = ringFixtureRail
			var err error
			options.ringProgramID, err = protocol.HashBytes([]byte("ring_test_program_aaaaaaaaaaaaaa"))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			options.inputRingData = []*big.Int{big.NewInt(0xD0), big.NewInt(0xD1)}
			options.outputRingData = big.NewInt(0xD2)
			name, key, tag = "merge_ring", "merge_ring_8_1", 20
		}
		f := buildMergeFixture(t, options)
		c := &f.public
		for i := 1; i < len(c.TreeSlots); i++ {
			c.TreeSlots[i] = transaction.TreeSlot{ID: big.NewInt(0), UtxoRoot: big.NewInt(0), NullifierRoot: big.NewInt(0)}
		}
		field := func(v frontend.Variable) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%064x", spptest.AsBigInt(v)) }
		cache := make([]byte, 32)
		for i := range cache {
			cache[i] = 91
		}
		preimage := []byte{tag}
		for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
			preimage = append(preimage, 255)
		}
		preimage = append(preimage, spptest.AsBigInt(c.OutputHash).FillBytes(make([]byte, 32))...)
		preimage = append(preimage, 1)
		preimage = append(preimage, cache...)
		preimage = append(preimage, 5)
		c.ExternalDataHash = protocol.Sha256BEField(preimage)
		owner, err := protocol.OwnerHash(f.ownerPkHash, f.userNullifierPk)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		hashes := make([]*big.Int, len(f.inputs))
		zeros := make([]*big.Int, len(f.inputs))
		for i, in := range f.inputs {
			hashes[i], zeros[i] = big.NewInt(0), big.NewInt(0)
			if spptest.AsBigInt(in.Domain).Int64() == 3 {
				hashes[i] = spptest.MustUtxoHash(t, protocol.Utxo{Domain: big.NewInt(3), Owner: owner, Asset: f.asset, Amount: spptest.AsBigInt(in.Amount), Blinding: spptest.AsBigInt(in.Blinding), DataHash: big.NewInt(0), RingDataHash: spptest.AsBigInt(in.RingDataHash), RingProgramID: f.ringProgramID}, big.NewInt(7))
			}
		}
		blind, err := protocol.PrivateTxBlinding(spptest.AsBigInt(c.Nullifiers[0]), f.userNullifierSecret)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		c.PrivateTxHash = spptest.MustPrivateTxHash(t, hashes, []*big.Int{spptest.AsBigInt(c.OutputHash)}, zeros, spptest.AsBigInt(c.ExternalDataHash), blind)
		chain, err := protocol.HashChain4(spptest.ToBigInts(c.Nullifiers))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fields := []*big.Int{chain, spptest.AsBigInt(c.OutputHash), spptest.MustTreeSlotsHashChain(t, publicTreeSlots(c.TreeSlots)), spptest.AsBigInt(c.OutputTreeID), spptest.AsBigInt(c.PrivateTxHash), spptest.AsBigInt(c.ExternalDataHash), big.NewInt(1)}
		var circuit, assignment frontend.Circuit
		if ring {
			fields = append(fields, f.outputRingDataHash, f.ringProgramID)
			f.publicInputHash = hashChain4(t, fields)
			circuit, assignment = merge.NewMergeRingCircuit(8), f.ringCircuit()
		} else {
			fields = append(fields, f.userSigningPkHash)
			f.publicInputHash = hashChain4(t, fields)
			circuit, assignment = merge.NewMergeCircuit(8), f.defaultCircuit()
		}
		ccs, err := frontend.Compile(ecc.BN254.ScalarField(), r1cs.NewBuilder, circuit)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		system, err := common.ReadSystemFromFile("../../proving-keys/" + key + ".key")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		witness, err := frontend.NewWitness(assignment, ecc.BN254.ScalarField())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		proof, err := groth16.Prove(ccs, system.(*common.TransferProofSystem).ProvingKey, witness)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		public, err := witness.Public()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = groth16.Verify(proof, system.(*common.TransferProofSystem).VerifyingKey, public); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		p := proof.(*bn254.Proof)
		p.Ar.Neg(&p.Ar)
		ar, bs, krs := p.Ar.RawBytes(), p.Bs.RawBytes(), p.Krs.RawBytes()
		nullifiers := make([]string, len(c.Nullifiers))
		for i, n := range c.Nullifiers {
			nullifiers[i] = field(n)
		}
		value := map[string]any{"nullifiers": nullifiers, "output": field(c.OutputHash), "state_root": field(c.TreeSlots[0].UtxoRoot), "nullifier_root": field(c.TreeSlots[0].NullifierRoot), "private_tx_hash": field(c.PrivateTxHash), "proof_a": hex.EncodeToString(ar[:]), "proof_b": hex.EncodeToString(bs[:]), "proof_c": hex.EncodeToString(krs[:])}
		if ring {
			value["output_ring_data_hash"] = field(f.outputRingDataHash)
		}
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out := os.Getenv("CACHE_FIXTURE_DIR")
		if out == "" {
			t.Fatal("CACHE_FIXTURE_DIR required")
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(out+"/"+name+".json", append(data, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
